purpose: Correctness contract for provenance-compatible, evidence-separated multiresolution galactic tile summaries.

cases.invariant: all eight complete direct children sum row counts and produce complete parent coverage
seven complete children cannot produce a complete parent
complete empty tile and unknown tile are distinguishable
same child octant cannot be merged twice; rejected merge is atomic
different frame/epoch transform digests cannot merge
observed, inferred and synthetic layers cannot be blended
only immediate child summaries can be merged
checked overflow leaves prior aggregate state unchanged

benchmark_next_steps: quantified fixed-point photometric flux conservation by named band/unit schema
data-backed source-identity uniqueness and partition receipts
reproducible larger-scale storage projection, distinctly marked extrapolated
claim_ceiling: Summary record counts are not estimates of all physical stars.
Coverage is relative to the declared dataset selection, not the whole Milky Way.
No photometric flux, population count estimate or completeness claim is made by this initial implementation.
No speed superiority claim is made.
